statement.en: Drawers in turn are one model, each with a floor, on one law of best response: what a drawer keeps above its floor returns to it at least one for one; so where two drawers have no floor, revision and perfection both come to the floors, whatever the others' floors.
statement.zh: 轮流的抽取者是一个模型，各有下限，依一条最优回应之律：抽取者在下限之上所留至少一对一地回到自身；故两个抽取者无下限时，不论其他下限，修订与完美都达到下限组合。

laws.en: One model: at each step k drawers draw in turn, drawer d leaving of what it is given at least its floor and at most all of it; a profile revises another where each rule is a best response against it at every step from every level, and is perfect where it revises itself.
laws.zh: 一个模型：每步 k 个抽取者轮流，抽取者 d 对所给至少留其下限、至多全留；一个组合修订另一个，若每条规则在每步、从每个水平都是对它的最优回应；组合修订自身即完美。

laws.en: One law: what a best response keeps above its floor returns to it at least one for one; so it leaves its floor where what it keeps returns less than one for one, a drawer draws to capacity wherever what it draws later is fixed, and every drawer at the last step.
laws.zh: 一条律：最优回应在下限之上所留至少一对一地回到自身；故所回少于一对一之处留下限，此后所抽固定之处抽到容量，最后一步每者皆然。

laws.en: Where two drawers have no floor, whatever the others' floors, what any drawer keeps passes through one of them, so nothing returns: every sequence of revisions reaches the floor profile, a revision always exists, and every perfect profile is the floor profile, which is perfect; with no floor anywhere that is drawing everything.
laws.zh: 两个抽取者无下限时，不论其他下限，任一抽取者所留经过其一，故不回到自身：每个修订序列达到下限组合，修订总存在，每个完美组合即下限组合且它完美；处处无下限即全部抽取。

laws.en: Where a drawer leaves nothing the base stands at what stands at nothing, and on a web every dependence above it, met at the start, is broken at the first step.
laws.zh: 某抽取者不留之处，基础立于零处所立者；在网上，起始时被满足、高于它的每个依存在第一步被打破。

laws.en: Drawing at once, the same law: where the level is divided into portions and all draw at once, what a drawer leaves returns to it only through its portion; where that return is less than one for one, every perfect profile and every revision draws everything, and a dependence above what stands at nothing is broken.
laws.zh: 同时抽取，同一条律：水平分为份额、众者同时抽取时，抽取者所留只经其份额回到自身；此回报少于一对一时，每个完美组合与每次修订都全部抽取，高于零处所立者的依存被打破。

laws.en: The converse, exactly: drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last, no drawer's portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what it alone leaves while the others draw everything; a perfect profile draws everything at the last step; on a web the drain then breaks a dependence above what stands at nothing.
laws.zh: 确切的逆命题：无下限地同时抽取时，全部抽取是完美的，当且仅当在最后一步之前的每一步，没有抽取者的下一步份额对其在他者全部抽取时独留之量所回多于一对一；完美组合在最后一步全部抽取；在网上，此时抽干打破高于零处所立者的依存。

laws.en: Whom restraint pays: where each portion returns less than one for one, in whole amounts a portion never rises with what is left, so along no profile does any drawer draw more than where all draw everything, and what the drain breaks lies beyond every drawer; where a profile holds the level and draws a drawer at every later step more than its portion of what stands at nothing, over a horizon at least two steps longer than its first portion it draws that drawer more.
laws.zh: 克制使谁得益：每份所回少于一对一时，以整数量计份额从不随所留而升，故沿任何组合，没有抽取者比众者全部抽取时多得，抽干所破者在每个抽取者之外；某组合保持水平、在此后每步给某抽取者多于其在零处所立者中的份额时，在比其首份长两步以上的视野上，它使该抽取者多得。

laws.en: The standpoint of the whole as a case: a drawer whose portion is all that stands finds drawing everything imperfect wherever the whole returns more than one for one; one drawer given the whole drains exactly where the whole never does, and where it never does the drain is perfect for it and still breaks what depends on the base.
laws.zh: 全体的立场作为情形：份额为全部所立者的抽取者，在全体所回多于一对一处不以全部抽取为完美；得全体的单一抽取者恰在全体从不多回之处抽干，此时抽干对它完美而仍打破依存于基础者。

laws.en: Witnesses: under the gate, alone an optimum keeps the dweller, restraint keeps it, and every perfect profile and every revision from restraint breaks it; under doubling with a one-unit floor on the second, the first leaves everything from three and the dweller is kept; under halves, what both leave standing next with half of it again, drawing everything is perfect for the two and breaks the dweller, leaving all but one unit of each half holds the source at six, keeps the dweller and draws each drawer more, and for a single drawer given the whole draining is no best response.
laws.zh: 见证：门控下单独的最优与克制保持居者，每个完美组合与自克制的每次修订打破它；倍增且第二者下限为一单位时，第一者自三全留，居者得以保持；对分之下，两者所留于下一步再加其半而立，全部抽取对二者完美并打破居者，各留其半而只取一单位则把源保持在六、保持居者并使每个抽取者多得，对得全体的单一抽取者，抽干不是最优回应。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Any law G of what stands; k drawers in turn at each step, each leaving between its floor and what it is given; plain sums over the steps that remain; rules reading the drawer, the step and the level; for the drain and the revision two drawers with no floor, the start leaving at most what it is given; natural amounts, discrete steps.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。任一所立之律 G；每步 k 个轮流的抽取者，各自留于其下限与所给之间；其后各步之和；规则读取抽取者、步与水平；抽干与修订两个抽取者无下限，起始组合至多留所给；自然数量，离散步。

does_not_show.en: Drawing at once, which profiles are perfect where some portion returns more than one for one, and whether every perfect profile of the halves draws each drawer less than holding; which profiles are perfect where at most one drawer has no floor, away from the last step.
does_not_show.zh: 同时抽取时，某份所回多于一对一处何种组合完美，以及对分中每个完美组合是否都使每个抽取者少于保持所得；至多一个抽取者无下限时最后一步之外何种组合完美。

does_not_show.en: Revision that is not a best response: noisy, partial or local learning.
does_not_show.zh: 非最优回应的修订：有噪声、部分或局部的学习。

does_not_show.en: That the drain is a harm or restraint better: no evaluation enters; the laws say what profiles do.
does_not_show.zh: 抽干是伤害或克制更好：没有评价进入；这些律只说组合做什么。
